div.div: 2 طنّاهُ , inf. n. تَطْنِيَةٌ, He treated him to cure him of the disorder of the spleen mentioned above; (S, K;) namely, a camel, (S,) or a man: (K:) and he cauterized him (i. e. his camel) in his side; (K, TA;) or, as in the Nawádir of Lh, طنّى بَعِيرَهُ فِى جَنْبَيْهِ he cauterized his camel [in his sides] by reason of the disorder above mentioned: and the cure [or curing] of that disorder is [also] the taking a wooden peg, and laying him [i. e. the camel] upon his side on the ground, and making, between his ribs, incisions [therewith], not penetrating through. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
